tasks.subject: Task 1: Translate README.md to English
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the French README with an English version, fixing the `current` command reference and the `yourorg` placeholder URL.

**Files:**
- Modify: `README.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All prose is in English
- [ ] `go install` URL uses `github.com/cyrillesondag/gg-version`
- [ ] `git clone` URL uses `github.com/cyrillesondag/gg-version`
- [ ] Quick-start shows `gg-version next`, not `gg-version current`
- [ ] No French words remain

**Verify:** `grep -ic "current" README.md` → 0; `grep "yourorg" README.md` → 0 lines

```json:metadata
{"files": ["README.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -ic \"current\" README.md && grep \"yourorg\" README.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["All prose in English", "cyrillesondag URL in go install and git clone", "gg-version next in quick-start", "no French words"]}
```
